const props = defineProps<{ over: Over | null; status: DnDStatus }>();

    const bin = (props.over?.data as { bin?: SVGElement | null } | undefined)?.bin?.getBoundingClientRect();

      '--dy': `${bin.top + bin.height * 0.3 - (from.top + from.height / 2)}px`,

  },
  // Once the removal has rendered: the bin may have moved with the photo gone.
  { flush: 'post' },
);

import { ref, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';

const COLORS = ['#f59e0b', '#42b883', '#3b82f6', '#ec4899', '#a855f7', '#14b8a6', '#ef4444', '#84cc16'];
const swatches = ref(COLORS.slice(0, 5).map((hex, id) => ({ id, hex })));
let created = swatches.value.length;

const animated = ref(true);
const grid = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('grid');
// Drags animate by default. `animateChanges` also animates the changes no drag made: the
// buttons below replace the array, and the tiles move, fade in and fade out.
const { items } = makeSortableList(grid, { items: swatches, strategy: 'grid', animateChanges: animated });

const shuffle = () => {
  const next = [...swatches.value];
  for (let i = next.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    [next[i], next[j]] = [next[j]!, next[i]!];
  }
  swatches.value = next;
};

const add = () => {
  const used = new Set(swatches.value.map((swatch) => swatch.hex));
  const hex = COLORS.find((color) => !used.has(color));
  if (hex) swatches.value = [{ id: created++, hex }, ...swatches.value];
};

const sort = () => {
  swatches.value = [...swatches.value].sort((a, b) => COLORS.indexOf(a.hex) - COLORS.indexOf(b.hex));
};

const remove = (id: number) => {
  swatches.value = swatches.value.filter((swatch) => swatch.id !== id);
};

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, watch } from 'vue';
import { motion, useMotionValue, useReducedMotion, useSpring, useTransform, useVelocity } from 'motion-v';
import { useDnD, type DnDStatus, type DragItem } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';

const props = defineProps<{ items: DragItem[]; status: DnDStatus }>();
const flag = computed(() => props.items[0]?.item as { letter: string; hue: number });

// The overlay lives under the provider, so it can read the drag: the pointer's speed
// swings the flag, held by its top edge. Still, it hangs straight.
const { pointer } = useDnD();
const x = useMotionValue(pointer.value?.x ?? 0);
watch(
  () => pointer.value?.x,
  (value) => value !== undefined && x.set(value),
);
const swing = useSpring(useTransform(useVelocity(x), [-1500, 0, 1500], [-25, 0, 25]), { stiffness: 300, damping: 14 });
const calm = useReducedMotion();
</script>

<template>
  <motion.div
    class="flag-overlay"
    :style="{ '--hue': flag.hue, rotate: calm ? 0 : swing }"
    :initial="{ scale: 1 }"
    :animate="{ scale: status === 'dropping' || calm ? 1 : 1.1 }"
    :transition="{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 500, damping: 22 }"
  >
    <span class="cloth">{{ flag.letter }}</span>
  </motion.div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeSortableList } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import Flag from './Flag.vue';
import FlagOverlay from './FlagOverlay.vue';

const WORD = 'SPRING';
// The word's letters, shuffled. Colored in the word's order: spelled, they make a rainbow.
const flags = ref([...'RSIGPN'].map((letter) => ({ id: letter, letter, hue: (WORD.indexOf(letter) * 55 + 340) % 360 })));
const spelled = computed(() => flags.value.map((flag) => flag.letter).join('') === WORD);

const list = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('list');
const { items } = makeSortableList(list, { items: flags, strategy: 'horizontal', overlay: FlagOverlay });
</script>

<template>

    <ol ref="list" class="string">
      <Flag v-for="flag in items" :key="flag.id" :flag="flag" />
    </ol>
    <p class="goal" :class="{ spelled }">{{ spelled ? 'Spelled!' : `Spell ${WORD}` }}</p>
